text.p: Logistics provider FlightMasters/SeaMasters(FIRSTAIR INC) opened its first international office in London.
The company said FlightMasters (UK), Ltd. replaces an earlier, exclusive agent relationship in London and will position it to work with larger clients between all US cities and the UK.
In addition to agent relationships in 42 countries, FlightMasters/SeaMasters said it has offices in Minneapolis/St. Paul, Chicago, Dallas/Fort Worth, Los Angeles, and San Francisco.

The company, founded in 1986, provides a full range services including customs brokerage, in-bound procurement, assembly/distribution, warehousing, and time-specific delivery services. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
